name: Switches: plates, levers, doors and lifts
body: One channel system: plates, levers and light crystals power doors, lifts and bridges. Collision is switched by moving the piece away, as glow platforms do (engine-follow-ups/game-controlled-collision-for-world-entities).

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's feedback that the Crimson and Thorn loop needs prototyping: more companion mechanics, more variety, a fuller level slice.

acceptance_criteria: A plate, a lever and a door work by channel
Pieces hide and show with collision
